steps.content: You've been away from town for some time now. Deep in the forest, the fog grows thicker.

You walk side by side with the Clergyman, who remains attentive and thoughtful, guiding you around the countless dangers lurking in the forest. Along the way, he even shares some of the fairy tales that circulate within this story world.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: How did you find a place like this?

steps.speaker: Clergyman
steps.content: After coming here so many times, I've already figured out the boundaries of this world. Even the NPCs seldom reach here.
After walking for a short while, a black cottage appears before you, starkly different from the village houses. Beside it stands only a single menacing tree with a crooked trunk.
Then again, it shouldn't surprise you that a cottage or a staircase can appear out of nowhere in this kind of story.
The Clergyman pulls open the cottage door and you step inside. The interior is pitch black. Certainly an ideal hideout.
There's a soft click, but the Clergyman's footsteps never follow. Instead, a cold gust of wind rushes from behind, shoving you deeper into the cottage!

The moment you enter, the space seems to be split apart and rearranged by an invisible hand. The black room is rapidly compressed into something resembling a black hole. Though you're standing on level ground, you feel yourself plummeting at terrifying speed.
At last, you glimpse the light reflecting off the Clergyman's glasses, shrinking further and further away...
